messages:
Elaine (PM): Hey team — I pushed a PRD draft for the Console observability changes: retention controls, tracing sampling UI, and the dashboard UX flows. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/observability-prd

Sam (Eng): reading it now. can we clarify the MVP scope? the doc lists 90/365 retention presets + per-route overrides — feels big for a single sprint.

Mike (SRE): +1 to scope concern. storing full traces for 365 days at current ingest rates will blow up storage/cost. We need hot/cold tiers or a sampling strategy.

Anya (Design): I'll sketch the settings modal and the route-level toggle today. Thinking: admin settings → default retention (30/90/365) + tenant override UI + 'archive to S3' CTA.

Luis (Product): Customers asking for long retention are mainly mid-market/enterprise. We should gate 365-day retention behind dedicated/dedicated+ package or admin opt-in. That reduces product risk for self-serve teams.

Elaine (PM): Proposed MVP (narrow): 1) Admin-level retention presets (30/90 days) 2) Per-route sampling toggle (on/off + error-force) 3) Basic dashboards with retention filter and trace sampling visual. Out-of-scope for MVP: 365-day default, per-tenant billing, cold storage export. Thoughts?

Sam (Eng): That MVP is much more reasonable. For sampling, recommend default = adaptive sampling: 1% baseline, 100% for errors/slow requests, with override in UI. Example config we can ship:
```
tracing_sampling:
  default_rate: 0.01
  force_on_error: true
  slow_threshold_ms: 1500
  adaptive_burst: 0.1
```
Would need a flag for 'full_trace_on_error' so business teams can inspect failures.

Mike (SRE): Implementation notes: adaptive sampling requires low-latency decision at edge. We can approximate with a token-bucket per pod. Also need a retention GC that drops trace blobs older than X days. We should model cost impact: roughly 3x current storage at 30 days if we keep full KV cache + traces.

Nora (Legal): reminder: some customers (healthcare/finance) may require 7+ years in certain jurisdictions. We must surface that as a compliance caveat and add an 'export' button in the PRD so teams know how to request long-term storage. Do not promise long retention in self-serve.

Anya (Design): UX flows: Admin > Observability > Data retention modal. Steps: choose preset, optional per-route overrides (table), 'Export older than X to...' CTA, and confirm dialog for reducing retention (warn about irreversible deletion). Will mock screens by EOD.

Elaine (PM): Acceptance criteria (draft) — please mark thumbs up or comment inline: 1) Admins can set default retention to 30 or 90 days. 2) Per-route sampling toggle exists and respects 'force on error'. 3) Dashboard filter allows selecting retention window and shows accurate counts. 4) Traces older than retention window are permanently deleted (GC) and documented. 5) UX shows clear warnings and an 'export' path for compliance customers.

Luis (Product): Add: rollout criteria — telemetry stable for 48h with sampling enabled and no more than 2% increase in median latency on runtime path. Also require cost delta estimate reviewed by finance before wide rollout.

Sam (Eng): Edge cases to capture in PRD comments: - Tenant overrides that conflict with org-wide minimums - What happens to traces linked to stored embeddings/alerts? - Retention change from higher->lower while queries in-flight - Partial archive failures (export retries/backoff)

Mike (SRE): Operational acceptance: automated reclaim job for retention must expose metrics: last_run, deleted_count, error_rate. Also add revert plan if deletion pipeline breaks.

Nora (Legal): For export flow include audit log entries and KMS-required encryption metadata. Also a checkbox for customers to confirm policy adherence.

Elaine (PM): Scope negotiation note: if we can't get export + cold storage in Q1, we'll ship admin presets + sampling + dashboards then follow up with export in Q2 as a paid add-on. Is that OK?

Luis (Product): OK from product. we'd prioritize gated long-retention for Dedicated customers first.

Anya (Design): I'll design the opt-in flows for Dedicated vs self-serve — small variations but same screens, disabled options for self-serve.

Sam (Eng): I'll add implementation tasks to the RFC: sampling hook in ingress, retention GC job, admin UI endpoints, dashboard retention filter. Need API for 'export request' (POST /v1/observability/exports).

Elaine (PM): Great. I'll update the PRD with: final MVP list, acceptance criteria, rollout guardrails, and the edge-case appendix. Expect an updated doc by morning. Please add short comments on the doc rather than long threads. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging: observability-retention/v1 at 1769004500

Sam (Eng): I'll validate sampling behavior on staging after deploy and post results here.

Mike (SRE): I'll run the storage/cost sim with 30/90 day profiles and share numbers before we merge.

Elaine (PM): Thanks all — closing loop. Comments on the doc preferred.
